Loss report: gitlab -> gitea
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci trigger.pipeline_done (the source runs on the events pipeline, parent_pipeline and its file has no trigger form for them; Gitea has no event for them)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci trigger.resource (the source runs on the events external, chat and its file has no trigger form for them; Gitea has no event for them)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/4 trigger.api (event repository_dispatch is not supported by Gitea; the trigger is dropped)
[external] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/3 trigger.schedule: add on: schedule: - cron: <the cron of your GitLab pipeline schedule> to the workflow: GitLab keeps the schedule in the project settings, so the workflow has no schedule event and the job starts by workflow_dispatch (the schedule names no cron expression)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci job.if: !github.event.deleted on every job (GitHub Actions runs a push workflow when a branch is deleted and the source starts no run for that; each job condition ends with the guard)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/check job.runner: default runner label ubuntu-latest (the IR holds no runner label)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/check step.action: actions/checkout step (GitLab clones the repository before every job; GIT_DEPTH and GIT_SUBMODULE_STRATEGY map to the step inputs, and GHA does not clone)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/compile job.runner: default runner label ubuntu-latest (the IR holds no runner label)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/compile step.action: actions/checkout step (GitLab clones the repository before every job; GIT_DEPTH and GIT_SUBMODULE_STRATEGY map to the step inputs, and GHA does not clone)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/package job.runner: default runner label ubuntu-latest (the IR holds no runner label)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/package step.action: actions/checkout step (GitLab clones the repository before every job; GIT_DEPTH and GIT_SUBMODULE_STRATEGY map to the step inputs, and GHA does not clone)
[native] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/check/synth/checkout step.action (resolves against DEFAULT_ACTIONS_URL; default github)
[native] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/compile/synth/checkout step.action (resolves against DEFAULT_ACTIONS_URL; default github)
[native] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/package/synth/checkout step.action (resolves against DEFAULT_ACTIONS_URL; default github)
